alt: 初學者拿著簡單的畫得意地向老師炫耀，老師身旁卻擺著技法成熟、細節豐富的作品。
scene_prompt: 班門弄斧 means showing off one's modest skill in front of a true expert. Modern art studio: a novice teenager confidently and boastfully displays his very simple awkward pencil sketch of a house, chin raised and one hand making a proud presentation gesture, directly to a quiet experienced art teacher. Beside the teacher on an easel stands her impressive detailed ORIGINAL graphite architectural drawing of the SAME house subject, richly shaded and skillfully constructed. The mismatch in skill is unmistakable; teacher gives a patient mildly amused smile, no mocking crowd or bullying. Show the novice unaware of the expertise in front of him, not a humble student asking for help. No artist signatures, writing or borrowed famous artworks.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. Modern everyday setting when appropriate. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist. Scene:
